subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Meltwater - M2 status + a distribution-shift risk
body:
Status: M1 landed on time - Jorge's ChampSim patch produces clean CRC2-style LLC traces and Quentin's policies reproduce the expected gains over LRU/heuristics on the championship workloads.

M2 is a week late (trace tap went live Apr 20, thanks Zeke's team) but data is flowing: 240M accesses captured from retrieval serving so far. First learned policy on our traces shows an 11.4% miss-rate reduction vs. production LRU in offline replay.

The risk: our production access patterns shift hard around index rebuilds - the every-6-hours rebuild causes a burst pattern CRC2 never sees, and during those windows the learned policy's advantage drops to ~2% and briefly goes negative on one shard. Quentin wants to add rebuild-window traces to the training mix; that's a ~2 week add and would push M3 from May 22 to Jun 5, outside our window.

Options for the go/no-go: (a) report as-is with the rebuild caveat, (b) extend. Preference from us is (a) - the caveat is honest and the serving experiment would surface it anyway.

Milan
